chapter_title_en: Winds Stir Beyond the Seas – Escape
chapter_seo_title: RMJI Chapter 604 – A Sky Full of Fang, a Silent Sea, and No Safe Harbor
chapter_meta_description: Han Li and the ladies escape the Netherworld Domain, but an army of flying Yin beasts and a ghostly-mist vacuum nearly drag them back. A silent sea awaits.
og_title: RMJI Ch. 604 – Winds Stir Beyond the Seas: Escape
og_description: The Crying Soul Beast holds off a thousand Yin beasts as Han Li fights free of Stormwind Mountain. A new, dangerous sea awaits.
twitter_description: Fleeing the Netherworld Domain with two ladies, a giant ape, and a sky full of flying fangs. The sea is too quiet.

lore_anchors.definition: A rare beast-type spirit creature with an innate ability to consume Yin energy, ghostly matter, and souls; deployment in RMJI is tactical tool-use, not pet-bonding.
A pair of unfinished demon-forged wings that grant the user high-speed flight and the Lightning Evasion Technique.
A high-speed teleportation technique that allows the user to flicker short distances as if teleporting; extremely draining on qi reserves.
A ghost-mist realm beneath Stormwind Mountain where spiritual energy is replaced by Yin energy, weakening cultivators and hosting Yin beasts.
A set of flying swords refined by Han Li from Azure Bamboo; extremely sharp and can be controlled remotely via beast-tendon links even without qi.
A temporary, unstable tear in the fabric of reality between two realms; passing through it restores access to normal spiritual energy.
An animate black mist that expands over the sea, generates black lightning arcs, and exerts a powerful suction force on anything nearby; a hallmark of the Netherworld Domain's escape exit.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why does the Crying Soul Beast turn into a giant ape?
cultural_notes_faq.a: The Crying Soul Beast's "giant ape" form is its natural combat manifestation when it fully exerts its Yin-consuming aura. It is not a transformation spell but an innate property of the beast when suppressing large numbers of Yin entities at once. Think of it as a psychological area-denial weapon, not a pet evolving.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why do Han Li's swords work without mana?
cultural_notes_faq.a: Han Li's Azure Bamboo Cloudswarm Swords are physically extremely sharp and durable. Even without infusing them with qi, their bare material quality is lethal to smaller, weaker enemies like the foot-sized Yin beasts. This is a deliberate Mortal Stream trait: the quality of your gear matters, not just your cultivation level.
